== Summary ==
Identified: [[Emil Wallin]] (olive Mandalorian-hunter tee, blonde bun, seen from behind; same shirt as [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 8.jpg]]), [[Angelo Consoli]] (dark graphic tee, glasses, khaki pants), and [[Tamás Papp]] (blue shirt at the window table). The opponent at the window table, seen from behind, is not named.

Main event at the 2023 Naboo Regionals ("Foil Fest") weekend in Liverpool, UK, 3 June 2023, hosted by Team Wales.

* '''Event:''' [[2023 Regional Championships]]
* '''Date:''' 3 June 2023
* '''Date posted:''' 2023-06-03
* '''Identification:''' [[Emil Wallin]] (olive Mandalorian-hunter tee, blonde bun, seen from behind; same shirt as [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 8.jpg]]), [[Angelo Consoli]] (dark graphic tee, glasses, khaki pants), and [[Tamás Papp]] (blue shirt at the window table). The opponent at the window table, seen from behind, is not named.
